AI Moves Into Your Wallet: Perplexity, Portfolio Intelligence, and the New Competition for Financial Clients

By Will Zheng · April 13, 2026 · From Issue #6

Wealth Management / Finextra / Plaid / Perplexity Changelog Industry

Perplexity's March 27 product release formalized a move that financial services has been watching nervously: a Plaid-powered Portfolio feature that lets users connect brokerage accounts and query their real holdings conversationally — exposure summaries, allocation drift, risk scenarios, earnings synthesis. Plaid's announcement described it as enabling "personalized answers" against actual holdings data. Finextra noted it also unlocks Perplexity's Finance Computer — 40+ live tools sourced from FactSet, S&P Global, LSEG, SEC filings, and Coinbase — capable of generating interactive dashboards and Excel models. Critically, Perplexity's own terms of service explicitly state users should not rely on outputs for investment or financial advice, and the product does not place trades or move funds. But the ad targeting tells a different story about intent: "You've built wealth for years, but don't know your net worth" is a wealth manager's opening line, and Perplexity is now saying it to Facebook users at scale. ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot are moving in the same direction — from answering financial questions to sitting upstream of financial decisions, shaping client opinions before they ever speak to an advisor. For mass affluent users, this "good enough" insight layer is genuinely useful and arrives at near-zero cost. The competitive pressure on traditional advisors is not that Perplexity replaces them today — it's that it compresses the research and context-setting that once differentiated them, raising the bar for what personalization and planning actually need to deliver.

For wealth management leaders: The next competitive battleground is not robo-advisory — it's the AI layer that runs upstream of every client decision. The question to ask today: when a client types a financial question into Perplexity or ChatGPT at 10pm, what happens to that relationship by the time they call you?
